about: scripts/schedule-extract-eval.ts reads this. Every positive is graded on its next 5 runs after `now` in its zone (`tz`, else the file's). `rule`/`dtstart` are the expectation the runs were computed from, re-checked on every load; `alt` lists other defensible readings (with why). Hand-checked 2026-10-06.
